mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.description, p.author_id, p.author_name, p.latest_version, p.version_count, p.create_time, p.update_time,p.is_public, pv.id as plugin_version_id, pv.plugin_id as plugin_version_plugin_id, pv.version as plugin_version_version, pv.path as plugin_version_path, pv.file_size as plugin_version_file_size, pv.file_md5 as plugin_version_file_md5, pv.create_time as plugin_version_create_time, pv.changelog as plugin_version_changelog, pv.entity_package as plugin_version_entity_package, pv.method_package as plugin_version_method_package, pv.compatible_version as plugin_version_compatible_version, e.id as entity_id, e.description as entity_description, e.name as entity_name, e.plugin_version_id as entity_plugin_version_id, e.entity_name as entity_entity_name, a.id as attribute_id, a.description as attribute_description, a.entity_info_id as attribute_entity_info_id, a.type as attribute_type, a.name as attribute_name, mc.id as method_class_id, mc.description as method_class_description, mc.plugin_version_id as method_class_plugin_version_id, mc.class_name as method_class_class_name, mc.simple_class_name as method_class_simple_class_name, mc.package_name as method_class_package_name, m.id as method_id, m.description as method_description, m.method_class_id as method_method_class_id, m.name as method_name, m.return_type as method_return_type, param.id as parameter_id, param.description as parameter_description, param.method_id as parameter_method_id, param.name as parameter_name, param.type as parameter_type, param.order as parameter_order FROM plugin_info p LEFT JOIN plugin_version pv ON p.id = pv.plugin_id LEFT JOIN entity_info e ON pv.id = e.plugin_version_id LEFT JOIN attribute a ON e.id = a.entity_info_id LEFT JOIN method_class_info mc ON pv.id = mc.plugin_version_id LEFT JOIN method_info m ON mc.id = m.method_class_id LEFT JOIN parameter_info param ON m.id = param.method_id
mapper.update: UPDATE plugin_info SET description = #{description}, name = #{name}, author_name = #{authorName}, latest_version = #{latestVersion}, version_count = #{versionCount}, is_public = #{isPublic}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM plugin_info p WHERE p.author_id = #{authorId}
